title:
Epic to populate the selected model templates grid with data based on the action that triggered the epic.

If the action suffix is `ROW_ADDED` or `ROW_DELETED`, the epic will populate the
`Reliability.BulkModelConfigTemplateSelectionGrid_dataSpec_ds` with numbered rows.

If the action suffix is 'DATA_ADD', the epic will check that the action is triggered
for the first row of `Reliability.BulkModelConfigTemplateSelectionGrid` and populate it
with the default model template.

Else, the epic will assume it was triggered by a `DATA_MODIFY` action and it will populate the displayDescription
and displayWhenToUse on the `Reliability.BulkModelConfigTemplateSelectionGrid_dataSpec_ds`
based on the model template specified in the payload.

The payload for a `DATA_MODIFY` action will contain the following:
 `id`: The Id of the row that was modified.
 `newValue`: The new value that was set on the row. In this case, this new value
             is the model template id that was selected by the user.
 `field`: The field that was modified.

The payload for a `DATA_ADD` action will contain the following that is
relevant for the scope of what the epic does:
 `id`: The Id of the row that was added.
name: BulkModelConfigPopulateSelectedModelTemplatesEpic
